title: Integrating Factor and Euler's Method
welcome_lead: Solve linear ODEs with integrating factors and march numerically with Euler.
meta_desc: IBDP HL Maths adventure on integrating factor for linear ODEs and Euler's method.
final_note: Integrating factor: e^(∫P dx) makes left side a perfect derivative!

concepts.def: dy/dx + P(x) y = Q(x), first order linear.
Approximate solutions step-by-step from initial value.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Solve dy/dx + 2y = 6.

μ = e^(2x). (e^(2x) y)' = 6 e^(2x). Integrate: e^(2x) y = 3 e^(2x) + C. So y = 3 + C e^(-2x).
